text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The injury Calstone Light O sustained 
during training was more severe than 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Kh... What a blunder...!
choice_data_list: You need to rest for a while. Got it?
You need to rest for a while. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying it'll require long-term 
medical treatment?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I cannot accept that. Because that 
proposal... is a 'detour.'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to train every day and going 
straight forward, versus resting until I 
heal and taking a winding detour—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The gap is glaringly obvious. There is 
simply no making up for it.
choice_data_list:
Even if you keep going like that, you 
won't even be able to run in a straight 
line.
If you insist, I'll allow just one kind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Favoring an injury increases the strain on 
other areas. If you suffer an even greater 
injury, it could put your career as an 
athlete on the line.
choice_data_list:
I'll prepare a straight path for your 
comeback, so just hang in there for now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will believe in those 
words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Calstone Light O devoted 
herself to treating her injury for a 
while...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can train, I don't mind. 
Please.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Exercising in the pool reduces the strain 
on the legs, correct?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I'm not a child anymore 
either.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm off. Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOHHH, ow ow ow ow!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The injured spot hit the surface of the 
water directly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although pulled out of the pool, Calstone 
Light O's injury ended up getting 
worse..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand. Even moving forward bit 
by bit is far better than standing still.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm getting the hang of moving 
my body with less strain. With this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, by getting her exercise in the 
pool, she was able to return to her normal 
training routine early.
